title: Biggest Bundesliga seasons
brief: Name the ten players with the most Bundesliga goals in a single season from 2000/01 to 2025/26. Each player counts once, for his best season.

notes.Erling Haaland: Erling Haaland's best is 27 goals in 2020/21, just outside.
notes.Edin Dzeko: Edin Dzeko's best is 26 goals in 2008/09, just outside.
notes.Miroslav Klose: Miroslav Klose's best is 25 goals in 2005/06, just outside.
notes.Stefan Kiessling: Stefan Kiessling's best is 25 goals in 2012/13, just outside.

sources: Transfermarkt club season stats pages, every Bundesliga club 2000/01 to 2025/26 (players.csv, source column)
checks: Each player's best single season, goals for two clubs in one season added together (none of the top ten moved mid-season). Every figure matches the player's Wikipedia season table and the season's top scorer on the game's own bund-ts boards. Six players share fifth to tenth on 28, which fills the board exactly; Haaland is 11th with 27.
